deviceScan.title: Device check
deviceScan.subtitle: A quick look at this device and its connection
deviceScan.speedFailed: The speed test didn't finish. You can try it again.

overall.orange: It works. A few upgrades are worth considering
overall.red: Something here is likely causing stop-and-go playback

overallNote.yellow: If it works for you, it works. Nothing needs changing.
overallNote.orange: If it works for you, it works. When you want something better, the suggestions show where to start.
overallNote.red: The lines marked red are the likely cause. The suggestions show what to consider.
overallNote.none: Run the speed test, or check again in a moment.

find.hdrDecodeNo: HDR video: not supported by this device
find.link: Wi-Fi link to the router: {{mbps}} Mbps

why.ram: Devices with 2 GB of memory or less can stall or restart apps on busy channels. Consider one with 3 GB or more.
why.ramFree: Little memory is free right now. Restarting the device, or closing apps you don't use, usually helps.
why.cpu: Devices with fewer than 4 processor cores start channels and open the guide slowly.
why.cpu32: Devices with fewer than 4 processor cores start channels and open the guide slowly.
why.avcSw: Ordinary HD channels need hardware H.264 decoding; without it expect stutter. Consider a newer streaming device.
why.avcNone: Ordinary HD channels need hardware H.264 decoding; without it expect stutter. Consider a newer streaming device.
why.hevcSw: Many channels, and all 4K, use H.265. A device that decodes it in hardware plays them smoothly.
why.hevcNone: Many channels, and all 4K, use H.265. A device that decodes it in hardware plays them smoothly.
why.uhdNo: Your TV is 4K, but this device can't play 4K video. A 4K streaming device shows it at its best.
why.android: An older Android version: apps get fewer updates on it. Consider a newer device when you're ready.
why.webview: This device's web engine is old, which makes screens slower. Install an update for it if the device offers one, or consider a newer device.
why.storage: Storage is almost full: the device slows down and updates can fail. Remove apps you don't use.
why.netNone: This device isn't connected to the internet. Check the cable or the Wi-Fi.
why.band: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi is slower and crowded. Use your router's 5 GHz network, or a cable.
why.signal: The Wi-Fi signal is weak here. Move the router closer or higher, add a mesh point, or use a cable.
why.link: The link to the router is slow. A cable, a closer router or a newer router helps.
why.speed: Lower than steady streaming needs (about 15 Mbps for HD, 25 for 4K). Check what else is using the internet, or ask your internet provider.
why.ping: Slow responses make channels slow to start. A cable or a better router often helps.
why.screen: A Full HD or 4K TV shows today's channels at their best.

deviceScan.askQuestion: Here is my device check. In plain words, explain the ratings and what, if anything, is worth upgrading first, using the suggested devices listed.

send.title: Get help
send.intro: Snow Media gets this check with your note, and the answer shows in Support › Submit a Ticket.
send.introGuest: Support gets this check with your note. Tell us how to reach you.
send.includes: What's sent: the lines of the check (model, versions, memory and connection figures), the app's version and your Live TV line's username. Never your password.
send.notePlaceholder: For example: stops and starts in the evening
send.name: Your name
send.sent: Sent. We'll get back to you.
send.sentTicket: Sent. The answer will show in Support › Submit a Ticket.
send.needContact: Please enter an email or a phone number.
send.tooMany: Too many sends from here right now. Please try again in an hour.
send.failed: Couldn't send. Check the connection and try again.
